title: Software Engineering
summary: Debugging method, testing strategy, Pythonic idioms, git, API & data modeling, performance.

docs.summary: Systematic debugging: reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, instrument, fix, verify, prevent — and the traps to avoid.
Test pyramid, behavior-not-implementation, fixtures, mocking boundaries, property tests, coverage, flakes, pytest.
Pythonic patterns and pitfalls: comprehensions, generators, context managers, dataclasses, typing, EAFP, GIL, pathlib.
Practical git: atomic commits, good messages, rebase vs merge, bisect, reflog safety net, conflicts, safe undo.
REST/HTTP semantics, resource design, pagination/errors/versioning, input validation, relational modeling & indexes.
Measure-first, cProfile/timing, complexity intuition, caching, I/O vs CPU bound, avoiding premature optimization.
